summary: Iteration 49 - Ticket Enrichment + AI Triage Batch. All tests PASSED. Backend: 13/13 pass. Frontend: All new features working correctly. AI Triage categorizes/prioritizes/routes tickets. Client contacts display in dropdown. Rich text editor with image paste/drop support.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - cosmetic, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: AI Triage endpoint uses keyword matching (MOCKED - not real AI). Categories: network, security, hardware, email, software, backup, support
Priority detection uses urgency keywords: critical (down, outage, emergency), high (urgent, asap, broken), low (request, when you get a chance)
Skills matrix is hardcoded for Alex Thompson, Sarah Chen, Mike Rodriguez with skill scores 1-10 per category
Triage routing calculates score = skill * 10 - workload * 3 to balance skills vs current ticket load
Client contacts CRUD properly implemented at /api/clients/{client_id}/contacts
RichTextEditor uses TipTap with Image extension supporting paste and drag/drop
Conversation tab is now defaultValue='conversation' making it first and active by default
Contact selector in create ticket uses HTML datalist for autocomplete with name + email display
seed_data_creation: Client contacts seeded: Acme Corp (John Smith, Lisa Wong, Dave Miller), TechStart (Sarah Chen, Tom Harris), Global Finance (Robert Chang, Emma Davis, James Wilson)
